    • ERROR_TYPE_VALUE

      static final String ERROR_TYPE_VALUE
      Fixed error marker recorded in histogram attributes on failure.

      Intentionally low-cardinality: metrics use this constant to avoid unbounded label sets, while span attributes carry the actual exception class name for debugging.
